admitted_primary_source.receiving_changes: Independent ordered matrix factorization from exact CAA traces, both inverse identities, physical boundary estimates and explicit domains.

source_correspondence: B0 retains the actual CAA conormal coefficients, physical sign, boundary normalization and same complex amplitudes for both Airy functions.
B1 checks the mixed Hessian, graph direction, reduced half-density factors and ordered leading symbol g inverse times c. Ordinary graph composition supplies full remainders.
B2 obtains a positive scalar elliptic leading matrix from the actual row, includes the lower Robin term, constructs the order reducer and performs the negative-mu Fourier reflection explicitly.

B3 retains nested proper localizations and proves stability of smooth remainders under the graph and one-third calculus. Canonical support transfer uses ordinary cutoffs; no nonlinear invariance of the exotic class is assumed.

B4 applies the established matrix parametrix to these concrete factors and proves both inverse identities on the physical boundary. The opposite scalar mode is handled with its own reciprocal and unchanged complex lower matrices.
B5 transfers every real Sobolev estimate and wavefront direction through the actual graph maps and compatible distributional approximations.
B6 preserves the exact noncommuting reflection cancellation, all smoothing terms and the converse matching implication. No arbitrary weak interior decomposition is inferred.
B7 proves the localized distributional regularity estimate with a finite negative norm and a separated-cutoff smoothing error.
B8 proves completeness of the boundary graph domains, bounded inverse and reflection maps in their graph norms and the norm equivalence. These domains are not identified with weak interior traces.
Three exercises independently verify the nilpotent lower matrix, the nonlinear cotangent derivative obstruction and strict graph-domain inclusion through disjoint Fourier packets.
